learning_objective: 🎯 Take your decimal skills to the next level by multiplying, dividing, and solving real-world shopping and measurement puzzles!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Multiplying decimals is easy! First, ignore the decimal point entirely and multiply like normal numbers. Then, count the total number of digits behind the decimal points in both original numbers, and jump your decimal point back into the answer by that many steps.
When you multiply a decimal by 10, 100, or 1000, you just slide the decimal point to the RIGHT by the number of zeros. When you divide by 10, 100, or 1000, you slide the decimal point to the LEFT!
We use decimal division all the time when shopping. If 4 pens cost exactly ₹50.50, dividing that decimal total by 4 tells you the exact price of just one single pen down to the last paise.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Budget Calculator
fun_activity.instructions: Go to your kitchen and find a packet of spices. If a small 100-gram jar costs ₹45.50, divide the decimal to find the exact cost of 1 gram, and then multiply to find how much a massive 2.5 kg sack would cost!

quick_recap: ⭐ When multiplying, the final answer must have the same number of decimal places as the total places in the numbers you multiplied.
⭐ Multiplying by powers of ten slides the decimal right; dividing slides it left.
⭐ Always bring the decimal point straight up into your answer when doing long division with decimals.
